dedupe_keys.name: hpcact 2022 normal and anomalous data centre activity videos

description: HPCACT-2022 records normal and anomalous activities in a high-performance-computing facility for temporal activity detection. Idaho National Laboratory researchers publish video clips and frame-level annotations, including human activities and equipment-related events viewed from different angles. The README documents 2,560 by 1,920 video at 20 frames per second and JSON annotations containing filenames, duration, frame counts, bounding boxes and activity labels. The file tree lists 310 MP4 paths, including a sample subset; this is not an independently reconciled unique-video count. Coverage is a data-centre setting, with exact site extent and acquisition dates not established beyond the release identity. Public access uses Git LFS and the repository reports MIT. A limitation is that the repository is archived and explicitly no longer maintained, and the paper’s larger-duration claim was not reconciled against the available files. Simulation uses include testing visual monitoring components and constructing facility incident scenarios. No related catalogue dataset was identified as the same collection. Video payloads, compressed labels and trained models were not downloaded or executed, and the separate software DOI is retained as a citation, not assigned as a dataset DOI.
name: HPCACT-2022 normal and anomalous data-centre activity videos
